0.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_000
0.description: The basket is clearly designed to hold a large quantity of items, but for what purpose you cannot say...

1.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_001
1.description: Thank you so much for your contribution! We pray you will favor us with your generosity in the future as well.

2.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_002
2.description: As ever, you are too kind. Your donation has brought us to the limit of our weekly budget, and so I must refuse any additional contributions until our coffers have been replenished. Thank you again!

4.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_004
4.description: Though it pains me to do so, I must refuse any further contributions at this time. We have yet to allocate additional funds to pay gratuity for donations...

5.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_010
5.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

6.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_011
6.description: The proceeds from your contributions have already been used to great effect. But I would not have you take me at my word alone.

7.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_012
7.description: I pray you pay a visit to Mitsuba of the Ten Thousand Stalls. She should be glad to tell you of the progress they have made.

8.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_013
8.description: Before you think to make any further donations, I would ask that you go and speak with Mitsuba. You should know what you have helped to build.

9.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_018
9.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

10.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_019
10.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

11.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_020
11.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Ten Thousand Stalls have seen further development.

12.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_021
12.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

13.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_030
13.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

14.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_031
14.description: As you may recall, several Budugan tribesmen offered to provide introductions to Xaela traders in Reunion. Subsequent negotiations went well, and we have at last begun to receive shipments of foodstuffs and other goods from the Steppe!

15.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_032
15.description: Mitsuba can tell you more─and I expect she would like very much to do so.

16.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_033
16.description: You have yet to speak with Mitsuba, yes? I would encourage you to do so now. If you wish to make a donation, you may do so later.

17.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_038
17.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

18.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_039
18.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

19.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_040
19.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Ten Thousand Stalls have seen further development.

20.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_041
20.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

21.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_050
21.description: I cannot thank you enough, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I simply cannot.

22.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_051
22.description: I am pleased to announce that, at long last, our plans for the Ten Thousand Stalls are complete! Every tenant is open for business, and the food is the talk of the enclave!

23.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_052
23.description: You really must go and see. Mitsuba is expecting you!

24.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_053
24.description: Now, now, this is not the time to be making donations! Let us go and enjoy the Ten Thousand Stalls in all their glory!

25.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_060
25.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

26.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_061
26.description: Work on the Yard has begun in earnest, as you may have noticed. It will encompass a rather large section of the enclave, including the area directly behind me.

27.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_062
27.description: You see, after deliberation, the Shazenkai concluded that we would need to secure much more space for this plan to succeed─far in excess of what we designated for the Ten Thousand Stalls.

28.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_063
28.description: This might not have been the case had we not decided to carry out two proposals that are arguably at cross purposes...but so be it.

29.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_064
29.description: At the very least, I am told Master Tsuranuki is in high spirits. Perhaps you might consider calling on him and seeing the workers' progress?

30.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_065
30.description: Not that I wish to refuse you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I think it might be better if you were to go and see Master Tsuranuki before I accept another donation.

31.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_068
31.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

32.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_069
32.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

33.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_070
33.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Yard has seen further development.

34.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_071
34.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

35.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_080
35.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

36.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_081
36.description: As I am sure you are aware, the southern portion of the Yard under Master Tsuranuki's supervision is coming along quite well. Moreover, construction of the buildings adjacent to my office has begun.

37.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_082
37.description: Several of these buildings have been designated for the production of traditional Doman arts and crafts, including paper. You may recall the gentleman we met in the stalls the other day, Master Araragi? He will be overseeing matters there.

38.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_083
38.description: Come to think of it, perhaps you should go and introduce yourself to him? I know not if you have spoken with him since, but given the circumstances of that first meeting, he may not remember you...

39.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_084
39.description: Have you spoken with Master Araragi yet? I think it would be for the best if you did. I will review any items you wish to donate afterwards.

40.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_090
40.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

41.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_091
41.description: Much progress has been made on the Yard owing to Master Tsuranuki's guidance. I have no doubt he would enjoy telling you of his triumphs...

42.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_092
42.description: As it happens, I expect I will soon have wonderful news to deliver to him as well. I should be glad if you were present for it.

43.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_093
43.description: I am afraid I cannot accept donations at this time. A runner should be arriving for me any moment... In the meantime, perhaps you could go and speak with Master Tsuranuki? I will join you anon.

44.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_098
44.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

45.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_099
45.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

46.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_100
46.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Yard has seen further development.

47.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_101
47.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

48.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_110
48.description: Words cannot express how grateful we are to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

49.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_111
49.description: As you may recall, Master Tsuranuki bade us reallocate resources for the construction of housing for the recently returned refugees.

50.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_112
50.description: Though they are not yet finished, progress has been most swift, and soon we shall be able to give our brothers and sisters a proper welcome home.

51.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_113
51.description: Some improvements have also been made to the buildings behind me. Master Araragi can tell you more, if you like.

52.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_114
52.description: Are you not interested in hearing what Master Araragi has to say? I should be glad to process any donations when you return.

53.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_118
53.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

54.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_119
54.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

55.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_120
55.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Yard has seen further development.

56.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_121
56.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

57.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_128
57.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

58.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_129
58.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

59.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_130
59.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Yard has seen further development.

60.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_131
60.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

61.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_140
61.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

62.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_141
62.description: In case you were unaware, Master Tsuranuki's section of the Yard is finally complete! The carpenters and metalworkers are now capable of producing all manner of products for the people of Doma!

63.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_142
63.description: That racket you might be able to hear is them, already working up a storm. My accounts would not do it justice, though. Would you like to go and see?

64.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_143
64.description: Donations can wait. You should go and see Master Tsuranuki's craftsmen hard at work. Believe me when I say it is inspiring!

65.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_150
65.description: Thank you. To be honest, I never thought this day would come...

66.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_151
66.description: The Ten Thousand Stalls, complete. The Yard, complete!

67.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_152
67.description: All the projects we planned, everything we aspired to achieve, complete!

68.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_153
68.description: On this momentous occasion, Master Araragi wished to speak with us both. If you have a moment, I should be glad if you would accompany me...

69.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_154
69.description: You are too kind to offer yet more donations. That said, we really should not keep Master Araragi waiting...

71.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_TSURANUKI_000_161
71.description: Bwahahaha! She likes it, she likes it! A surprise to commemorate the completion of the Ten Thousand Stalls and the Yard, for the girl who made it possible!

72.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_162
72.description: I do not mean to sound ungrateful, but to use our valuable resources to decorate my office is...is...

73.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_ARARAGI_000_163
73.description: Long overdue, many would agree. Or were you planning to rebuild the whole of Doma save the Shazenkai?

74.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_ARARAGI_000_164
74.description: Consider too your position as the representatives of our reconstruction efforts. It would not do to receive potential patrons in a ramshackle hovel. I am sure even <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> would eventually begin to question your judgment.

75.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_165
75.description: Still... Isn't this a little... Oh, I don't know...

76.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_MITSUBA_000_166
76.description: We're not finished, either. Over here, girl. I've got another surprise for you and the rest of the Shazenkai.

77.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_MITSUBA_000_167
77.description: Now these are garments befitting the face of the Shazenkai!

78.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_168
78.description: Are you sure it isn't a bit...extravagant?

79.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_MITSUBA_000_169
79.description: Well, that's the point, isn't it!?

80.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_MITSUBA_000_170
80.description: If you're to engage the rich and influential, you'll need to do so on their terms. Show them that Doma is no poor backwater─that they'd be wise to invest in our future!

81.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_MITSUBA_000_171
81.description: Also, several merchants mentioned to me that you lot were impossible to pick out of a crowd, so there are practical considerations too. They can't well negotiate with you if they can't even find you, after all!

82.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_172
82.description: Fair points, all... Very well. If I must serve in a more public capacity for the sake of Doma, then I shall!

83.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_173
83.description: Lord Hien has placed his trust in us to manage this monumental task─to see our people's hopes and dreams realized. We shall not fail him!

84.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_174
84.description: I shudder to think where we would be without your assistance, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Your constant support has been invaluable.

85.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_175
85.description: But our grand design for the revitalization of the enclave is far from finished. When we have finalized our plans for the next step, I pray we can look to you once more.

86.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_176
86.description: The Doma in our memories and in our hearts will soon be ours again. Until that blessed day, let us never give up hope!

87.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_177
87.description: You have reached the conclusion of this chapter of the Doman reconstruction.

88.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_178
88.description: Forgive me, my friend, but until we settle upon our next plans for the development of the enclave, we will not be accepting further donations.

89.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_180
89.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! A pleasure to see you, as always.

90.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_181
90.description: I am, however, concerned that we are keeping you from more urgent matters. Are there not others in greater need of your assistance?

91.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_182
91.description: In order to proceed with the reconstruction of the enclave, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Emissary of the Dawn.”

92.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_183
92.description: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If you can spare a few moments, there is a matter I would like to discuss with you.

93.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_185
93.description: I expect that all will become clear once Ihase explains.

94.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_190
94.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

95.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_191
95.description: Ihase and the other farmers are working hard to develop the reclaimed land. I hear their new tools have made a world of difference.

96.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_192
96.description: While we are able to produce some of the necessary equipment here, our craftsmen are already working at maximum capacity. In many cases, it is quicker to simply purchase what we require.

97.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_193
97.description: Your contributions helped us secure these tools for Ihase and the others. If you are curious to know how their work is proceeding, why not pay them a visit?

98.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_194
98.description: Have you been to see Ihase? I think he has something to discuss with you.

99.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_200
99.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

100.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_201
100.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

101.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_202
101.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Enclave Demesne has seen further development.

102.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_203
102.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

103.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_208
103.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

104.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_209
104.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

105.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_210
105.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Enclave Demesne has seen further development.

106.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_211
106.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

107.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_215
107.description: Once again, allow me to thank you for your continued contributions.

108.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_216
108.description: Ihase tells me that everything we need for rice production is now ready.

109.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_217
109.description: The crops are growing remarkably well. If all goes according to plan, we can expect a decent harvest in a few moons.

110.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_218
110.description: Are you interested to see the progress Ihase has made with the paddy fields? Perhaps you should stop for a chat with him.

111.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_219
111.description: If you have a chance, I recommend that you stop by the Enclave Demesne to see the good that your donations have done.

112.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_225
112.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

113.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_226
113.description: Although construction of the school is proceeding quicker than expected, it is still little more than a place for the students to gather. Nonetheless, Minazuki has already started tutoring there.

114.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_227
114.description: The sheer enthusiasm on the faces of the children is a sight to behold! I am sure that Minazuki will not mind if you call in to observe one of the lessons.

115.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_228
115.description: I recommend going to the school to see what a positive change your donations have brought about. And who knows─you may even learn something while you are there!

116.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_235
116.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

117.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_236
117.description: Your contributions have led to truly remarkable improvements at Rissai-juku!

118.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_237
118.description: Of course, “seeing is believing,” as the saying goes. Minazuki would like nothing more than to show you the improvements to the school.

119.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_238
119.description: It appears that the school has changed a great deal since the last time you went to see Minazuki. Why not see for yourself?

120.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_245
120.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

121.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_246
121.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

122.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_247
122.description: Owing to your many contributions, Rissai-juku has seen further development.

123.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_248
123.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

124.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_255
124.description: Your contributions have, as always, had a profound effect on the enclave.

125.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_256
125.description: Minazuki informs me that Rissai-juku now has everything it needs. All of the necessary books and writing materials have been procured, and the school itself is the perfect environment for learning. Shall we go to see it for ourselves?

126.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HOZAN_100_256
126.description: While it was not my intention to eavesdrop, I could not help overhearing that you might be visiting the school. I did have a message for you, but it seems it no longer needs to be delivered.

128.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HOZAN_100_257
128.description: Come now, what is so strange about seeing a Doman man dressed in the traditional manner? Truth be told, most of us former refugees were glad for the chance to put on something more comfortable.

129.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HOZAN_110_257
129.description: All except the children, that is. They have grown so accustomed to their Eorzean clothing that they are reluctant to wear anything else! Far be it from me to deny them when they are so adamant...

130.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HOZAN_120_257
130.description: Oh yes, that reminds me. The little ones wanted me to bring you to the school. Apparently, they have something to show you.

131.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_258
131.description: I wonder what it could be? Thank you for letting us know, Hozan. Well then, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, shall we adjourn?

132.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_259
132.description: I cannot for the life of me imagine what the children wish to show us! There is only one way to find out, I suppose!

133.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_265
133.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

134.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_266
134.description: The basic foundations for the barracks are already in place, and construction is progressing well. The day it is completed cannot come soon enough!

135.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_267
135.description: Mauto is in charge. He is most likely standing outside, trying to look stern.

136.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_268
136.description: Would you be so good as to see if he needs any assistance?

137.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_269
137.description: If you speak with Mauto, he will explain everything. The barracks is not far from the Kienkan.

138.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_275
138.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

139.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_276
139.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

140.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_277
140.description: Owing to your many contributions, the Enclave Barracks has seen further development.

141.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_278
141.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

142.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_285
142.description: I offer my most sincere gratitude for your kind donations.

143.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_286
143.description: I have received word from Mauty as to the state of the barracks.

145.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_288
145.description: He would be most upset if he knew I had used that name.

146.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_289
146.description: You see, we grew up together, and “Mauty” was my nickname for him.

147.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_290
147.description: When we were little, he did not mind being called that, but now he tells me such a childish name ill befits a man of his standing.

148.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_291
148.description: Anyway, there are matters more deserving of your attention. What say we go and see the Enclave Barracks?

149.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_292
149.description: I must remember not to call him “Mauty” in front of his subordinates─ He would be dreadfully embarrassed!

150.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_295
150.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

151.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_296
151.description: We were able to cover the costs of having the old imperial tower completely demolished!

152.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_297
152.description: Not only that, but the masons and carpenters wasted no time in starting work on the new one.

153.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_298
153.description: If you would like to know more, I suggest speaking with Ishibushi, the foreman. He will explain how your donations are making a difference.

154.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_299
154.description: Should you have any queries regarding the watchtower, Ishibushi is the best person to ask.

155.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_305
155.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

156.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_306
156.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

157.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_307
157.description: Owing to your many contributions, the watchtower has seen further development.

158.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_308
158.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

159.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_315
159.description: Once more, your contributions are a great boon to the enclave.

160.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_316
160.description: Construction of the watchtower has reached its conclusion.

161.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_317
161.description: It makes me incredibly proud to think that such an impressive structure could come as a result of our combined efforts.

162.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_318
162.description: I believe that Ishibushi and the others should finish removing the scaffolding soon, so it should be safe to take a closer look.

163.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_319
163.description: Never mind the donations for now─ Do you not want to congratulate Ishibushi on the completion of the watchtower?

164.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_322
164.description: Your kind donations have helped secure the materials requested by Ishibushi.

165.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_ISHIBUSHI_000_323
165.description: Kozakura, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Hachisuba requests your presence at the Ten Thousand Stalls. Do you have time to spare?

167.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_325
167.description: By the kami! Was this all done in the short time we were away?

168.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_ISHIBUSHI_000_326
168.description: Yes. We had to prise you away from the Shazenkai long enough for the other builders to renovate it.

169.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_327
169.description: They certainly work quickly, don't they? It truly is remarkable!

170.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_ISHIBUSHI_000_328
170.description: What can I say? They learned from the best─ Me.

171.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_000_329
171.description: That is far from an empty boast, I assure you. Having received the master's tutelage, even a novice could put something like this together in no time at all.

172.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_000_330
172.description: You see, now that most of the construction of new buildings has been seen to, we can afford to divert our resources to improving the existing facilities.

173.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_000_331
173.description: The materials we requested were mostly for carrying out repairs, but we had enough left over to spruce up the Shazenkai. It is the least we could do to repay all the good you have done.

174.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_332
174.description: Come now, our contributions pale in comparison to all the backbreaking labor you do on behalf of the enclave.

175.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_333
175.description: Nonetheless, I gratefully accept your generosity! Thank you!

177.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_000_335
177.description: With that taken care of, perhaps we can have a well-earned rest!

178.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_336
178.description: Does that mean that most of your tasks have been completed?

179.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_ISHIBUSHI_000_337
179.description: For now, yes. Just a few odd jobs remaining.

180.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_338
180.description: Then I think it is safe to say that the reconstruction of the enclave is fini─

182.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_340
182.description: Oh, Tauyaku! What can I do for you?

183.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_TAUYAKU_000_341
183.description: I come to offer a proposal.

184.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_TAUYAKU_000_342
184.description: The enclave should have a garden!

186.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_TAUYAKU_000_344
186.description: I have the perfect location in mind. There is a pond behind the Ten Thousand Stalls, and the surrounding area is filled with a variety of trees and shrubs.

187.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_TAUYAKU_000_345
187.description: The area shows much promise, but will need the guiding hand of an experienced gardener─namely, myself─for it to fulfill its potential. With a few carefully cultivated plants and a new pavilion, tales of its beauty will spread throughout the land!

188.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_TAUYAKU_000_346
188.description: Now, I realize that strictly speaking, a garden is far from essential for daily life, which is why I have waited for more urgent matters to be addressed before making my proposal. What say you? Will you grant me the opportunity to bring a measure of joy to the citizenry?

189.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_347
189.description: I certainly have no objections. In fact, I think it is a wonderful idea!

190.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_348
190.description: We shall see to securing the necessary resources. However, this may require a few more donations. Can we rely on your support, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

192.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_ISHIBUSHI_000_350
192.description: A pavilion, you say? Leave it to me.

193.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_000_351
193.description: Master! If I may be so bold, I would very much appreciate you letting me handle this assignment!

194.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_000_353
194.description: Let us not forget that you are personally attending to a number of smaller─but no less important─tasks around the enclave.

195.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_000_354
195.description: I, on the other hand, have time to accept something rather demanding. And as you may remember, I once worked as a field hand─ Just one of the many occupations I dabbled in before finding my true calling. That experience will be useful when it comes to gardens, I am sure!

196.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_ISHIBUSHI_000_355
196.description: Fine, have it your way. A few days without your incessant prattle would do me a world of good.

197.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_TAUYAKU_000_356
197.description: Then it is decided! Come, I have much to explain.

198.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_360
198.description: On behalf of the Shazenkai, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I thank you for your support.

199.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_361
199.description: I am pleased to inform you that we have made great strides in our efforts to rebuild the enclave!

200.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_362
200.description: Owing to your many contributions, the One Garden has seen further development.

201.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_363
201.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

202.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_370
202.description: Please allow me to offer my most sincere appreciation for your kind donations.

203.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_371
203.description: Not only were they used in the development of the One Garden, but we also had enough materials left to carry out numerous repairs and improvements.

204.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_372
204.description: Through your goodwill and timely contributions, the enclave has changed immeasurably from the shattered husk it once was.

206.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_000_374
206.description: The One Garden is ready! You should come and see what we have done with the place.

208.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_376
208.description: We should go for a stroll and admire their handiwork.

209.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_HACHISUBA_100_376
209.description: You will not be disappointed─ I guarantee it! Now, I must find Master Ishibushi and share the news!

211.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_380
211.description: I wonder if anyone around the enclave knows about tento-okuri...

212.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_SYSTEM_000_381
212.description: Kozakura seems somewhat preoccupied. Perhaps she will respond if you speak with her directly.

213.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_385
213.description: Once I have tied up a few loose ends here, I shall join you for the tento-okuri. Please, go on ahead.

214.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_390
214.description: While I appreciate your offer of further donations, I have something I wish to say first.

215.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONCOLLECTIONBOX_00484_KOZAKURA_000_391
215.description: Please allow me a moment to compose myself.
